title: pvReductionFilter
body:
## pvReductionFilter

Generic parallel reduction (vtkReductionFilter): an optional pre-gather algorithm runs on each MPI process, the results are gathered, and a post-gather algorithm combines them on one or all processes. The helpers are named by VTK class name (PreGatherHelperName, PostGatherHelperName); the helper proxies themselves cannot be set in Schemaxis. In a serial run there is a single piece, so the operation mainly applies the helpers to it. Prefer pvAppendReduce for the common gather-and-append case.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- This proxy's ReductionMode labels for values 0 and 1 are swapped relative to VTK's meaning; read the ReductionMode help before choosing.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ReductionFilter`. Identity: `filters/ReductionFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input to the Reduction filter. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":[],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GenerateProcessIds` | If true, the filter will generate vtkOriginalProcessIds arrays indicating the process id on which the cell/point was generated. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PassThrough` | If set to a non-negative value, then produce results using only the node Id specified. | `{"minimum":-1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `-1` |
| `PostGatherHelperName` | Set the algorithm that takes multiple inputs and produces a single reduced output. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `PreGatherHelperName` | Set the algorithm that runs on each node in parallel. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ReduceTo` | Zero-based MPI rank that receives the gathered result in the two to-one-process modes. It is ignored by "Reduce all data to all processors", and in a serial run the only rank is 0. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ReductionMode` | Where the gathered result ends up. In this proxy's XML the first two labels are swapped relative to VTK: "Move all data to one processor" sets native value 0, which vtkReductionFilter defines as REDUCE_ALL_TO_ONE (the target process holds the result while the others keep their own data), and "Reduce all data to one processor" sets value 1, MOVE_ALL_TO_ONE (the other processes end with no data). "Reduce all data to all processors" gives every process the full result, at the highest memory cost. In a serial run all three give the same result. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Move all data to one processor","Reduce all data to one processor","Reduce all data to all processors"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Move all data to one processor"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {
    "PostGatherHelper": "unsupported property class: vtkSMProxyProperty",
    "PreGatherHelper": "unsupported property class: vtkSMProxyProperty"
  },
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvReductionFilter",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
